content.name: Example Telecommunicator Program
content.label: Starting template
content.description: An invented starting point. Rename it, then replace its phases, competencies, tasks, scales, and forms with your agency's own before publishing.

phases.name: Orientation
phases.description: Center tour, systems access, and observation at a trainer's side.

phases.name: Call Taking
phases.description: Answering and processing emergency and non-emergency calls under direct supervision.

phases.name: Radio Dispatch
phases.description: Working a dispatch position under direct supervision.

phases.name: Shadow
phases.description: Working independently while a trainer observes without intervening.

competencies.name: Call Interrogation
competencies.description: Obtains and verifies location, callback number, and nature of the emergency.

tasks.prompt: Processes a structure-fire call from first ring to dispatch.
Verifies a wireless caller's location with follow-up questions.

competencies.name: Map and Location Skills
competencies.description: Locates addresses, intersections, and landmarks using the center's mapping tools.

tasks.prompt: Locates a rural address by mile marker.

competencies.name: Radio Discipline
competencies.description: Uses clear text, correct unit identifiers, and concise transmissions.

tasks.prompt: Dispatches a medical call and acknowledges each unit's status.

competencies.name: Stress Management
competencies.description: Stays composed and effective during high-volume or emotional calls.

anchors.label: Unacceptable
anchors.definition: Contrary to training; requires immediate correction.

anchors.label: Meets standards
anchors.definition: Performs the task as trained, with acceptable speed and accuracy.

anchors.label: Superior
anchors.definition: Performs well beyond the standard expected at this phase.

anchors.label: Fail
anchors.definition: Did not perform the task as trained.

rating_modifiers.label: Not responding to training
rating_modifiers.description: The same issue continues after correction.

evaluation_forms.name: Daily Observation Report
evaluation_forms.instructions: Rate what you observed this shift against the standard. Mark a competency not observed rather than guessing.

evaluation_forms.name: Weekly Summary
evaluation_forms.instructions: Summarize the week's daily reports: progress, recurring issues, and the plan for next week.
